crossRefs.note: “What do you mean, that you use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, ‘The fathers have eaten sour…
“As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “you shall not use this proverb any more in Israel.
“When this people, or the prophet, or a priest, asks you, saying, ‘What is the message from Yahweh?’ Then you shall…
“Son of man, behold, they of the house of Israel say, ‘The vision that he sees is for many days to come, and he…
who say, ‘The time is not near to build houses. This is the cauldron, and we are the meat.’
who say, “Let him make haste, let him hasten his work, that we may see it; let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel…
They have denied Yahweh, and said, “It is not he. Evil will won’t come on us. We won’t see sword or famine.
The prophets will become wind, and the word is not in them. Thus it will be done to them.”
Those who put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near;
knowing this first, that in the last days mockers will come, walking after their own lusts
and saying, “Where is the promise of his coming? For, from the day that the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “Son of man, what is this proverb that you have in the land of Israel, saying, ‘The days are prolonged, and every vision fails?’
translations.bsb: “Son of man, what is this proverb that you have in the land of Israel: ‘The days go by, and every vision fails’?
translations.kjv: Son of man, what is that proverb that ye have in the land of Israel, saying, The days are prolonged, and every vision faileth?
translations.asv: Son of man, what is this proverb that ye have in the land of Israel, saying, The days are prolonged, and every vision faileth?
